prerequisites: Basic principles of programming, algorithms, data structures, time complexity.
Basic knowledge of graphs and graph algorithms.
Content offered in the Bachelor of Engineering (Leuven) in the courses "Methodology of Computer Science" and "Discrete Mathematics and Algorithms".

learning_outcomes.text: After completing this course, the student will have insight into and experience with advanced algorithms and data structures, generally applicable in the development of software systems. This course complements the (basic) knowledge of programming, algorithms, data structures, and discrete mathematics as previously covered in the civil engineering bachelor's program.
The student knows advanced data structures and can describe, use, adapt, evaluate, and compare them.
The student can select suitable data structures and algorithms for a concrete situation, possibly in an adapted version, and compare them taking into account their properties and complexity.
The student has insight into the theoretical analysis of advanced algorithms and data structures, and can apply them.

syllabus_topics: Algorithm Design: how to think about algorithm design?
Correctness: how to verify if algorithms work correctly, testing, experiments, ...
Complexity Analysis: how to compare different algorithms, how to analyze with respect to complexity, ...
Application domains and specific algorithms are covered as examples of the above aspects.
Basics: Bachman-Landau notations, calculating with complexity, probability
Illustrative applications and application domains (not exhaustive):
Various sorting algorithms (QuickSort, Linear time sorting, Shellsort, ...)
Graphs: pathfinding algorithms, spanning trees, maximum flow, ...

assessment_methods.method: Partial or permanent evaluation with exam during the examination period

assessment_rules: A resit takes place under the same modalities as the first examination opportunity. Scores that the student may have obtained during the semester are carried over for the resit.
institution: KU Leuven - Faculty of Engineering Science
degree: Bachelor in de ingenieurswetenschappen (Bachelor of Engineering Science, Leuven)
